title: How movies and vaudeville worked at the Palace
summary: Explains the movie-plus-live-show format, raised prices for the midnight show, risque acts, and pit bands.

story.theme_name: Medicine shows, minstrels, circuses and the black theater circuit
story.community_name: On the road with minstrel, carnival and tent shows

blocks.x: So there would be, so how would it work? I mean, you'd go to see a movie and the live vaudeville?

Right. In most cases, you went to see a movie and the vaudeville. See, in other words, they put the movie on so you could, so anybody come up late. That is, you get a chance to see the movie, but you really would be paying for the, because the owner had already paid for the movie. But the promotion of the show was another kind of thing. So the movie was like Little Lagnap, because the price would be raised. The price was raised about another 15 or 25 or 50 cents for the midnight show, see, or for the vaudeville show.
Would the vaudeville and movies go along all day, or just a...

It all depends. All depends on what kind of attraction it was. If it was a semi-risky thing, like with Lottipop Jones and those guys telling dirty jokes or whatever, well, it would probably be late evenings or at night. That would rarely go on in daylight hours, because really, whenever Mr. Mojie and those people had certain shows on, they would have out front that adults only or something of that nature. They practiced. They stayed within the law. They stayed within...
So when you say vaudeville, what do you mean?
You mean, would they do skits? Would it just...

No, it wasn't a skit. Well, sometime it probably would be a skit, but it would probably be routine activities of women dancing, men dancing, telling jokes, and going through semi-sexual gyrations, but they were a little more modified, not the explosive type of them where you see everything hanging out, not the old dirty type vaudeville or risky kind of thing. But, you know, they would hint at it. Otherwise, it's just like saying, I would rather see a woman in a gown that I could see through rather than to see her all in the nude. At least she leaves you something to look forward to.
One of these kind of things.
Would there be musical acts as well?

Musical acts also. They would have the band playing there. They had the pit band. They had a band down in the pit sometime, or they would also have another band on stage sometimes. It all depends on how big it was and how much money was invested. Well, you know, like any two people or any group of people sitting down and saying, well, we're bringing in X number headliner. What is it going to cost us? How much money can we spend? How much advertising do we have to do? How many people we have to set up in a hotel list, that, and the other socials, and so on. Just the way it was. So that's the story on that. So all in all, like I said, they brought it.
